title: Karaage output for one document
description: What karaage.run() returns for one document, and karaage.save() writes as <id>.json (docs/design-1.1.0.md, section 6). Every field is present; empty lists and null stand for absent values. Offsets and lengths count Unicode code points, like Python str indices.

document_id.description: Id of the input document. Integer ids are written as strings.

status.description: ok: every step ran without error. partial: every step ran, but some passages or statements failed and are listed in errors, so statements may be missing. failed: a step failed as a whole, and there are no actors, statements or main point.

errors.description: What failed, in pipeline order. Empty when the status is ok.

warnings.description: Input that looks wrong. Warnings never stop the run.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text, so that a later change to the text can be detected.

main_point.description: One sentence stating the central argument of the text.

main_point_method.description: single: from the whole text in one call. chunked: the text did not fit the context, so its parts were summarised and the summaries combined.

actors.description: The actors the text quotes or cites, as found by attribution. base_author, the text's own voice, is not listed.

statements.description: Every extracted statement, in extraction order (by passage, then actor), rejected ones included.

step.description: The step where the error happened.

passage.description: The passage whose statements could not be extracted, numbered from 1 as in the HTML report; null otherwise.

statement.description: Id of the statement that could not be rephrased or validated; null otherwise.

code.description: text-not-nfc: the text is not in Unicode NFC. text-has-carriage-return: it contains \r. text-not-english: too few of its words are common English words.

canonical_name.description: The full name of a person, the official name of an organisation, or the title of a document.

aliases.description: Other names the text uses for the actor.

kind.description: As in the snapshot specification; null for documents and unknown kinds.

id.description: <document_id>-s<n>, with n counted from 1 in extraction order, rejected statements included.

actor.description: The actor's canonical_name, or base_author for the text's own voice.

actor_aliases.description: The canonical name followed by the aliases; ["base_author"] for base_author.

text.description: The statement, rephrased to stand alone, and paraphrased when too close to the source wording. Null when rephrasing failed.

text_short.description: A one-sentence version of the statement. Null when rephrasing failed.

char_start.description: Start of the passage the statement comes from, inclusive.

rejection_reason.description: Why the statement was rejected; null when it is valid.

rouge2_precision.description: The higher ROUGE-2 precision of text and text_short against the passage; above 0.3 means too close to the source wording. Null when rephrasing failed.

paraphrased.description: Whether text or text_short was paraphrased to move away from the source wording.

in_text.description: The validator's answer: is the statement in the passage? Null when not validated.

actor_correct.description: The validator's answer: is the actor right? Null when not validated.

version.description: Karaage version, from its git tags.

commit.description: The git commit Karaage was built from; null in a source tree that was never installed.

profile.description: Name of the profile: a shipped profile, or custom:<name>.

profile_settings.description: The resolved profile: model id per backend, generation parameters, context size, reasoning switch-off and embedding model.

backend.description: lmstudio, openrouter, or openai for another OpenAI-compatible server.

model.description: The model id the profile asks for on this backend.

model_reported.description: The model id the server returned; null when the document needed no LLM call.

model_build.description: On LM Studio, the loaded build (publisher, format, quantization, loaded, context_length). On OpenRouter, {"providers": [...]}, the providers that served this document's requests. Null when unknown.

inferred_at.description: When the document was processed, in UTC, in the snapshot format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

step_seconds.description: Duration of each step that ran, in seconds.
